name: hold_door
text: A person stands beside an already-open door and holds it steady with the right hand extended sideways, then turns the head and torso slightly left to let someone pass. Keep right hand on the door and feet planted.

review.reason: 3帧全身约束，右手接触门的局部约束，身体保持自然微动；右手目标最大误差3.9厘米，循环首尾一致。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
